language.script: Thai script — a Brahmic-derived abugida with no spaces between words, distinctive curled/looped letterforms

terrainDescription.zh: 昭披耶河流域形成核心農業平原，北部近緬甸／寮國邊境為山地，南部則是狹長熱帶海岸與島鏈。
terrainDescription.en: The Chao Phraya river basin forms a fertile agricultural plain at the core, with mountainous terrain near the Myanmar/Laos border in the north and a long tropical coastline with island chains in the south.

plate.color: white background, black text, province name in Thai below the serial (standard private-vehicle format since 1997)

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Square concrete bollards painted black-and-white (alternating or bottom-white/top-black) — very common and distinctive

utilityPole.transformerMount: Square concrete poles with small pinholes running the full vertical length (unlike Sri Lanka, where holes stop partway); street-light pole bases often painted black-and-red or black-and-white

historicalContext.zh: 泰語使用自己的婆羅米系文字（與越南以外的多數鄰國所用拉丁字母不同），也是中南半島唯一靠左行駛的國家——雖未被正式殖民，但深受早期英國商業影響。
historicalContext.en: Thai uses its own Brahmic-derived script (unrelated to the Latin alphabet used by most neighbors except Vietnam) and is the only mainland Southeast Asian country to drive on the left — a legacy of early British commercial influence despite never being formally colonized.
